nodes.description: uint256 public totalSupply declared in ERC20 and ERC223Basic, set to INITIAL_SUPPLY in TaurusPay constructor.
bool transfersEnabled flag gating transfer/transferFrom; toggled by enableTransfers.
mapping(address => uint256) balances, the token ledger updated by transfer/mint/claim.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed, ERC20 allowance ledger used by transferFrom/approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval.
address public owner; privileged account, receives ETH, source of minted balances, changed by changeOwner.
mapping(address => bool) public contractUsers; declared but unused access-control related flag.
bool mintingFinished; set true by finishMinting, checked by canMint modifier and mint/claim.
uint256 tokenAllocated counter of tokens sold/claimed, incremented in buyTokens and claim.
mapping(address => uint) countClaimsToken tracking number of claims per beneficiary in calcAmount.
uint256 priceToken = 950000, conversion rate used in validPurchaseTokens.
uint256 priceClaim wei required per claim; modified by setPriceClaim.
uint256 numberClaimToken base reward amount used in calcAmount; modified by setNumberClaimToken.
uint256 startTimeDay lower bound of daily claim window; modified by changeTime.
uint256 endTimeDay upper bound of daily claim window; modified by changeTime.
ERC223Token.transfer(address _to, uint _value, bytes _data) public onlyPayloadSize(3); updates balances then makes external tokenFallback call.
ERC223Token.transfer(address _to, uint _value) public onlyPayloadSize(2) returns(bool); updates balances then external tokenFallback call with empty data.
ERC223Token.balanceOf(address _owner) constant returns balance from balances mapping.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public onlyPayloadSize(3); moves balances and decrements allowed.
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public; sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-first protection.
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant; reads allowed mapping.
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue); adds to allowed via SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue); subtracts from allowed via SafeMath.sub.
TaurusPay fallback function() payable public; forwards msg.sender to buyTokens.
TaurusPay.buyTokens(address _investor) public payable; computes tokens, mints, forwards msg.value to owner.
TaurusPay.validPurchaseTokens(uint256 _weiAmount) public returns(uint256); multiplies wei by priceToken and enforces limits.
TaurusPay.finishMinting() onlyOwner canMint public returns(bool); permanently sets mintingFinished.
TaurusPay.changeOwner(address _newOwner) onlyOwner public returns(bool); transfers contract ownership.
TaurusPay.enableTransfers(bool _transfersEnabled) onlyOwner public; toggles transfersEnabled.
TaurusPay.mint(address _to, uint256 _amount, address _owner) canMint internal returns(bool); moves balances from owner to recipient.
TaurusPay.claim() canMint public payable returns(bool); time-gated payable claim that computes amount and forwards msg.value to owner.
TaurusPay.calcAmount(address _beneficiar) canMint internal returns(uint256); decaying reward computation using mul/div.
TaurusPay.validPurchaseTime(uint256 _currentTime) canMint public view returns(bool); checks daily time window.
TaurusPay.changeTime(uint256 _newStartTimeDay, uint256 _newEndTimeDay) public; MISSING onlyOwner, anyone can change the claim window.
TaurusPay.claimTokensToOwner(address _token) onlyOwner; sweeps ETH or arbitrary-token balance to owner via external call.
TaurusPay.setPriceClaim(uint256 _newPriceClaim) external onlyOwner; updates priceClaim.
TaurusPay.setNumberClaimToken(uint256 _newNumClaimToken) external onlyOwner; updates numberClaimToken.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used as investor, beneficiar and allowance owner.
block.timestamp (now), miner-influenceable time value used to gate claim eligibility.
External call receiver.tokenFallback(msg.sender, _value, _data) inside transfer(address,uint,bytes); reentrancy entry point.
External call receiver.tokenFallback(msg.sender, _value, empty) inside transfer(address,uint); reentrancy entry point.
owner.transfer(weiAmount) external value call at end of buyTokens; potential reentrancy into payable logic.
owner.transfer(msg.value) external value call in claim after balance mutations.
Arbitrary external call token.transfer(owner, balance) on user-supplied token address in claimTokensToOwner.
owner.transfer(address(this).balance) external value call in claimTokensToOwner ETH branch.
Arithmetic _weiAmount.mul(priceToken) in validPurchaseTokens; multiplication overflow surface.
Arithmetic numberClaimToken.mul(105 - 5*step).div(100) in calcAmount; reward calculation arithmetic.
address _to receiver parameter of ERC223Token.transfer(address,uint,bytes).
uint _value amount parameter of ERC223Token.transfer(address,uint,bytes).
bytes _data metadata parameter forwarded to tokenFallback.
uint256 weiAmount = msg.value local in buyTokens.
uint256 tokens result of validPurchaseTokens in buyTokens.
uint256 amount = calcAmount(beneficiar) local in claim.
uint256 currentTime = now local in claim feeding validPurchaseTime.
uint step = countClaimsToken[_beneficiar] local in calcAmount.
address _investor parameter of buyTokens receiving minted tokens.
uint256 _weiAmount parameter of validPurchaseTokens.
address _beneficiar parameter of calcAmount used to index countClaimsToken.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as _investor into buyTokens, letting any caller choose the mint recipient.
msg.sender becomes beneficiar in claim, so caller fully controls the claim recipient identity.
block.timestamp indirectly flows in as _currentTime determining whether a claim window is open.
claim reads now into currentTime, making claim eligibility dependent on miner-controllable timestamp.
transfer(address,uint,bytes) writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to] via SafeMath.
transfer(address,uint) writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to].
transferFrom debits balances[_from] and credits balances[_to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve directly overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] without zeroing.
increaseApproval adds _addedValue to allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval subtracts _subtractedValue from allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
mint credits balances[_to] and debits balances[_owner].
claim credits balances[beneficiar] and debits balances[owner].
claim increments tokenAllocated by the calculated amount.
buyTokens adds purchased tokens to tokenAllocated.
calcAmount reads and increments countClaimsToken[_beneficiar] to cap claims.
calcAmount derives the reward from numberClaimToken.
validPurchaseTokens multiplies _weiAmount by priceToken to size the purchase.
claim reads balances[owner] and sends the claim fee to owner.
buyTokens uses owner as the mint source and ETH transfer destination.
changeOwner reassigns the privileged owner variable under onlyOwner.
finishMinting irreversibly sets mintingFinished under onlyOwner canMint.
enableTransfers toggles the global transfersEnabled flag under onlyOwner.
changeTime writes startTimeDay with no onlyOwner guard, letting anyone extend/deny the claim window.
changeTime writes endTimeDay with no onlyOwner guard, an unprivileged state mutation.
setPriceClaim rewrites the claim fee under onlyOwner.
setNumberClaimToken rewrites the reward base under onlyOwner.
transfer requires transfersEnabled to be true before moving balances.
transfer(address,uint) requires transfersEnabled before moving balances.
transferFrom requires transfersEnabled before moving balances.
fallback function calls buyTokens(msg.sender) allowing plain ETH sends to mint.
buyTokens invokes validPurchaseTokens to compute the purchase size.
buyTokens calls internal mint to issue tokens from the owner balance.
claim requires validPurchaseTime(currentTime) before proceeding.
claim calls calcAmount to determine the decaying reward.
transfer(address,uint,bytes) performs the external receiver.tokenFallback call, enabling reentrancy.
transfer(address,uint) performs the external receiver.tokenFallback call, enabling reentrancy.
buyTokens ends with an external owner.transfer value call after minting.
claim performs an external owner.transfer value call to the privileged owner.
claimTokensToOwner performs an arbitrary attacker-supplied token.transfer external call.
claimTokensToOwner performs owner.transfer(address(this).balance) external value call.
validPurchaseTokens executes _weiAmount.mul(priceToken), an arithmetic operation guarded only by SafeMath.assert.
calcAmount executes numberClaimToken.mul(105 - 5*step).div(100) reward arithmetic.
The recipient's tokenFallback callback can re-enter transfer(address,uint,bytes) before the caller's transaction settles.
The recipient's tokenFallback callback can re-enter transfer(address,uint) via the notified contract.
If owner is a contract its fallback can re-enter buyTokens during owner.transfer.
If owner is a contract its fallback can re-enter claim during owner.transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: address _to is a parameter that only exists to scope the transfer(address,uint,bytes) logic; fold it into that function node.
uint _value is a local-scope parameter of transfer(address,uint,bytes); fold it into that function node.
bytes _data is a parameter passed directly to the tokenFallback external call; fold it into the transfer function.
weiAmount is the msg.value local computed inside buyTokens; fold it into the buyTokens function.
tokens is the result local of validPurchaseTokens used only inside buyTokens; fold it into buyTokens.
amount is the calcAmount result local used only inside claim; fold it into claim.
currentTime local reading now exists only within claim; fold it into claim.
step local derived from countClaimsToken is used only inside calcAmount; fold it into calcAmount.
_investor parameter only scopes buyTokens recipient logic; fold it into buyTokens.
_weiAmount parameter only scopes validPurchaseTokens math; fold it into validPurchaseTokens.
_beneficiar parameter only scopes calcAmount lookup/update logic; fold it into calcAmount.
